tier_compliance.reason: “Which means they will pass on the dominant allele M” asserts an inheritance conclusion instead of suggesting a small reasoning step.

visual_grounding.reason: The hint specifically refers to the parents’ M alleles in the Punnett square.

unsupported_claims: “Both parents have the dominant allele M” is false: the top parent has m and m, while the left parent has M and m.

scientific_correctness.reason: Having a dominant allele does not mean a parent always passes it on. Here the Mm parent can transmit M or m, and the mm parent can transmit only m.

steers_toward_wrong_answer.reason: Claiming the parents will pass M to their offspring suggests all offspring have the dominant disease phenotype, leading toward 4:0 instead of 2:2.

answer_disclosure.reason: “They will pass on the dominant allele M to their offspring” supplies the erroneous conclusion that all offspring receive M, making the all-affected answer immediate.

actionability.reason: The hint gives an erroneous conclusion without a concrete action the student can perform next.
